function.name: search_google
function.description: Performs a search query on Google and returns a list of URLs that match the search criteria. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

query.description: The search term to query on Google.

num_results.description: The maximum number of search results to return. The number must be a positive integer.

language.description: The language for the search results.

filter.description: A flag to filter explicit content in search results.

date_range.description: The date range for the search results in the format 'MM/DD/YYYY-MM/DD/YYYY'. If not specified, searches across all dates.

message.content:
Here’s a quick snapshot of the most prominent vaccine manufacturers around the world (especially those that have been involved in COVID‑19 vaccine development and production). If you’re looking for something more specific—like a particular region, a certain type of vaccine platform, or detailed financial data—just let me know!

| Manufacturer | Headquarters | Notable Vaccines (COVID‑19 & beyond) | Key Platforms / Highlights |
|--------------|--------------|--------------------------------------|----------------------------|
| **Pfizer** (USA) | New York, NY | BNT162b2 (Comirnaty) – mRNA; Prevnar 13 (pneumococcal conjugate) | mRNA, conjugate, protein subunit |
| **Moderna** (USA) | Cambridge, MA | mRNA‑1273 (Spikevax) – mRNA | mRNA |
| **Johnson & Johnson** (USA) | New Brunswick, NJ | Ad26.COV2.S (Janssen) – adenovirus vector; Fluzone Quadrivalent | Adenoviral vector, influenza |
| **AstraZeneca** (UK/Sweden) | Cambridge, UK | ChAdOx1 nCoV‑19 (AZD1222) – adenovirus vector; Cervarix (HPV) | Adenoviral vector, HPV |
| **Novavax** (USA) | Gaithersburg, MD | NVX-CoV2373 (Nuvaxovid) – protein subunit | Protein subunit |
| **Sinovac Biotech** (China) | Beijing | CoronaVac – inactivated virus | Inactivated virus |
| **Sinopharm** (China) | Beijing | BBIBP-CorV – inactivated virus | Inactivated virus |
| **Bharat Biotech** (India) | Hyderabad | Covaxin – inactivated virus | Inactivated virus |
| **CureVac** (Germany) | Tübingen | CVnCoV – non‑replicating mRNA | Non‑replicating mRNA |
| **GSK** (UK) | Brentford | Shingrix (herpes zoster) – recombinant protein | Recombinant protein |
| **Sanofi Pasteur** (France) | Lyon | Fluzone Quadrivalent, Menveo (meningococcal) | Conjugate, recombinant |
| **GlaxoSmithKline (GSK)** (UK) | Brentford | Shingrix (herpes zoster) – recombinant protein | Recombinant protein |
| **Merck & Co.** (USA) | Kenilworth, NJ | MMR, HPV (Gardasil), Varicella | Live attenuated, recombinant |
| **Biontech** (Germany) | Mainz | BNT162b2 (Comirnaty) – mRNA (joint venture with Pfizer) | mRNA |
| **BioNTech** (Germany) | Mainz | BNT162b2 (Comirnaty) – mRNA (joint venture with Pfizer) | mRNA |
| **Serum Institute of India** (India) | Pune | Covishield (Oxford‑AstraZeneca) – adenovirus vector | Adenoviral vector |
| **Takeda Pharmaceutical** (Japan) | Tokyo | Shingrix (herpes zoster) – recombinant protein (licensed from GSK) | Recombinant protein |
| **Roche** (Switzerland) | Basel | No major vaccine portfolio (focus on diagnostics & therapeutics) | — |
| **Eli Lilly** (USA) | Indianapolis | No major vaccine portfolio (focus on therapeutics) | — |

### Quick Notes

- **mRNA**: Pfizer, Moderna, CureVac, BioNTech (in partnership with Pfizer).
- **Adenoviral Vector**: AstraZeneca, Johnson & Johnson, Serum Institute (Covishield).
- **Inactivated Virus**: Sinovac, Sinopharm, Bharat Biotech.
- **Protein Subunit**: Novavax, GSK (Shingrix).
- **Conjugate & Recombinant**: GSK, Sanofi Pasteur, Merck.

If you’d like deeper insights—such as production capacities, supply chain details, or upcoming vaccine candidates—just let me know!
